Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human sodium-dependent dopamine transporter (CHEMBL238). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id for compound_key. Join docs on activities.doc_id for pubmed_id_or_doi. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Filter by target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL238' and activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
